title: Sensor output type differs from the program's assumption
summary: A presence sensor was replaced with a normally closed (light-operated vs dark-operated) variant: the PLC now sees 'part present' when nothing is there.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: A presence sensor was replaced with a normally closed (light-operated vs dark-operated) variant: the PLC now sees 'part present' when nothing is there.

troubleshooting.effect: Inverted presence signal; counters and sequences go wrong
symptoms: Part counter counts when parts leave instead of when they arrive
Input is TRUE with no part in front of the sensor
evidence: Sensor LED and PLC input LED with and without a target
Input tag value in the Watch list
diagnosticMethod: Place and remove a target while watching the input
Compare with the data sheet of the original sensor
repair: Install a sensor with the correct switching function or reconfigure it if it is programmable
troubleshooting.explanation: Sensors exist as normally open and normally closed variants; replacing one with the other inverts the signal without any visible damage.
